verses.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच। यथा ब्रूयान्महाप्राज्ञो यथा ब्रूयाद्विचक्षणः। यथा वाच्यस्त्वद्विधेन भवता मद्विधः सृहृत् ॥१॥
verses.english: The blessed God said You have spoken as a greatly wise man should-you have spoken as a sharp man should, even as should be spoken by a friend like you to a friend like me.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मार्थयुक्तं तथ्यं च यथा त्वय्युपपद्यते। तथा वचनमुक्तोऽस्मि त्वयैतत्पितृमातृवत् ॥२॥
verses.english: This has the merit of being conversant with morality and worldly good and truth to that degree which proper for you; the words which have been spoken by you are like the advice of a father or a mother.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यं प्राप्तं च युक्तं वाऽप्येवमेव यथाऽऽत्थ माम्। शृणुष्वागमने हेतुं विदुरावहितो भव ॥३॥
verses.english: What you have told me is true and worthy of being followed and is even what I have described it to be; listen with attention to the reason of my coming here, O Vidura.

verses.sanskrit: दौरात्म्यं धार्तराष्ट्रस्य क्षत्रियाणां च वैरताम्। सर्वमेतदहं जानन् क्षत्तः प्राप्तोऽद्य कौरवान् ॥४॥
verses.english: The wickedness of soul of the sons of Dhritarashtra and the hostility of the Kshatriyas, knowing full well, all this, 0 Khattva have I now come to the sons of Kuru.

verses.sanskrit: पर्यस्तां पृथिवीं सर्वां साश्वां सरथकुञ्जराम्। यो मोचयेन्मृत्युपाशात् प्राप्नुयाद्धर्ममुत्तमम् ॥५॥
verses.english: He that will relive this earth of her burden consisting of horses, chariots, elephants, he that will liberate her from curse of Death will earn great religious merit.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मकार्यं यतन् शक्त्या नो चेत्प्राप्नोति मानवः। प्राप्तो भवति तत्पुण्यमत्र मे नास्ति संशयः ॥६॥
verses.english: Attempting with all his might to do a virtuous act, if a man does not accomplish it, he gets the religious merit of having done the act. About that I have no doubt.

verses.sanskrit: मनसा चिन्तयन् पापं कर्मणा नातिरोचयन्। न प्राप्नोति फलं तस्येत्येवं धर्मविदो विदुः ॥७॥
verses.english: Thinking of a sinful act in his mind, if a man does not accomplish it, he does not get the consequences of that act. Utter those that are conversant with religion.

verses.sanskrit: सोऽहं यतिष्ये प्रशमं क्षत्तः कर्तुममायया। कुरूणां सृञ्जयानां च सङ्ग्रामे विनशिष्यताम् ॥८॥
verses.english: Therefore shall I with all, sincerity try to establish peace, O Khattva among the Kurus and the Srinjayas, for they will meet with ruins in the case of war.

verses.sanskrit: सेयमापन्महाघोरा कुरुष्वेव समुत्थिता। कर्णदुर्योधनकृता सर्वे ह्येते तदन्वयाः ॥९॥
verses.english: This exceedingly grave calamity has its rise in the Kurus; for it has been brought about by Karna and Duryodhana. All these are but their followers.

verses.sanskrit: व्यसने क्लिश्यमानं हि यो मित्रं नाभिपद्यते। अनर्थाय यथाशक्ति तन्नृशंसं विदुर्बुधाः ॥१०॥
verses.english: He, who does not seek to serve a friend suffering from a calamity by trying to the best of his abilities, is said to be a cruel man by the wise.

verses.sanskrit: आकेशग्रहणान्मित्रमकार्यात् संनिवर्तयन्। अवाच्यः कस्यचिद्भवति कृतयत्नो यथाबलम् ॥११॥
verses.english: A friend should be turned back from improper act even by seizing his hair. That being so, how can a man be blamed, if he strives with all his might.

verses.sanskrit: तत्समर्थं शुभं वाक्यं धर्मार्थसहितं हितम्। धार्तराष्ट्रः सहामात्यो ग्रहीतुं विदुरार्हति ॥१२॥
verses.english: It is proper therefore, O Vidura, for the son of Dhritarashtra along with his ministers to accept my blessed advice capable of doing good and consistent with morality and worldly profit.

verses.sanskrit: हितं हि धार्तराष्ट्राणां पाण्डवानां तथैव च। पृथिव्यां क्षत्रियाणां च यतिष्येऽहममायया ॥१३॥
verses.english: With all sincerity shall I strive for the good of the sons of Dhritarashtra and of the Pandavas and indeed of the Kshatriya race of the world.

verses.sanskrit: हिते प्रयतमानं मां शङ्केद्दुर्योधनो यदि। हृदयस्य च मे प्रीतिरानृण्यं च भविष्यति ॥१४॥
verses.english: If Duryodhana suspects me, striving for his good as I do, I shall at least be satisfied with myself in my heart and I shall be discharging the debt (I owe them as a friend).

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञातीनां हि मिथो भेदे यन्मित्रं नाभिपद्यते। सर्वयत्नेन माध्यस्थं न तन्मित्रं विदुर्बुधाः ॥१५॥
verses.english: In a dispute between cousins, the friend who does not serve them as a mediator with all his might, is not said to be a friend at all by wise men.

verses.sanskrit: न मां बूयुरधर्मिष्ठा मूढा ह्यसुहृदस्तथा। शक्तो नावारयत् कृष्णः संरब्धान् कुरुपाण्डवान् ॥१६॥
verses.english: In order that unrighteous, foolish and unfriendly people may not call me that Krishna though competent did not dissuade the Kurus and Pandavas inspired with rage against each other.

verses.sanskrit: उभयोः साधयन्नर्थमहमागत इत्युत। तत्र यत्नमहं कृत्वा गच्छेयं नृष्ववाच्यताम् ॥१७॥
verses.english: And for being of service to both the parties have I come here. And having made attempts in that direction I shall escape blame of men.

verses.sanskrit: मम धर्मार्थयुक्तं हि श्रुत्वा वाक्यमनामयम्। न चेदादास्यते बालो दिष्टस्य वशमेष्यति ॥१८॥
verses.english: If after listening to my beneficial advice, they do not accept it, the fool will feel the consequence of his luck.

verses.sanskrit: अहापयन् पाण्डवार्थं यथावच्छमं कुरूणां यदि चाचरेयम्। पुण्यं च मे स्याच्चरितं महात्मन् मुच्येरंश्च कुरवो मृत्युपाशात् ॥१९॥
verses.english: If without sacrificing the interests of the Pandavas I can bring about their peace with the Kurus, then I shall have done a meritorious act, O great-souled one; and the Kurus shall have been liberated from the shackles of death.

verses.sanskrit: अपि वाचं भाषमाणस्य काव्यां धर्मारामामर्थवतीमहिंस्राम्। अवेक्षेरन् धार्तराष्ट्राः शमार्थां मां च प्राप्तं कुरवः पूजयेयुः ॥२०॥
verses.english: I hope that the sons of Dhritarashtra will attend to me when I speak to them words of wisdom, based on the principles of virtue and humanity and that the Kurus will treat me when I go there, with respect.

verses.sanskrit: न चापि मम पर्याप्ताः सहिताः सर्वपार्थिवाः। क्रुद्धस्य प्रमुखे स्थातुं सिंहस्येवेतरे मृगाः ॥२१॥
verses.english: All the rulers of the earth united together are not powerful enough to stand before me in battle when I am angry, like all other animals before a lion.

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              इत्येवमुक्त्वा वचनं वृष्णीनामृषभस्तदा। शयने सुखसंस्पर्शे शिश्ये यदुसुखावहः ॥२२॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Having said these words that foremost of the Vrishnis and cause of the happiness of the Yadus, then laid down on his bed pleasant to the touch.
